tex_content.html: \begin{exercise} \end{exercise} 1. ch2:2-14Suppose $(\tilde{M}, \tilde{g})$ and $(M, g)$ are compact connected Riemannian manifolds, and $\pi : \tilde{M} \to M$ is a $k$-sheeted Riemannian covering.
